title: Longhorn / Operations
description: Adapted from onzack Longhorn Monitoring & Backups at 5265da9049d733bf90fb6649b0f5c55ed7c76e7d (Apache-2.0; see longhorn-dashboard.LICENSE). Modified for Longhorn 1.12.1 one-hot states, the VictoriaMetrics datasource, local backup exemptions and thresholds, explicit missing data, capacity and I/O. Source: https://github.com/onzack/grafana-dashboards/blob/5265da9049d733bf90fb6649b0f5c55ed7c76e7d/grafana/longhorn/onzack-longhorn-monitoring.json

panels.title: Health · check metric coverage before trusting the counts

panels.description: Cluster-wide. Successful manager scrapes as a percentage of desired Longhorn manager pods. Anything other than 100% is red. Partial scrape loss can undercount health and backup panels. Missing metrics remain No data.
panels.title: Scrape coverage

panels.description: Detached volumes normally report unknown robustness. Check attachment state in Longhorn before treating this as a fault; unknown on an attached volume needs investigation.
panels.title: Unknown health

panels.description: Cluster-wide BackupTarget/default availability, exported from the CR by kube-state-metrics.
panels.title: Backup target

panels.description: The active one-hot robustness state for every selected volume. Unknown is displayed explicitly.
panels.title: Volume health

panels.description: Ready, schedulable, and allowScheduling must all be true for a node to accept replicas. Namespace and PVC filters do not apply.
panels.title: Node conditions · cluster-wide
Backups · explicit opt-outs excluded; stale means more than 30 hours

panels.description: Selected Longhorn volumes excluding the no-backup PVC label. Uses the same exemption recording rule as the alerts.
panels.title: Backup expected

panels.description: A successful backup within 30 hours. This is a snapshot of freshness, not proof a restore will work. Shows zero when all selected volumes are explicitly exempt; if every expected volume lacks a timestamp, this shows No data. Partial gaps are counted in Missing timestamps.

targets.expr: sum((time() - ((longhorn_volume_last_backup_at{cluster="k8s-prod",pvc_namespace=~"$namespace",pvc=~"$pvc"} unless on (cluster,pvc_namespace,pvc) longhorn:volume_backup_exempt{cluster="k8s-prod"}) > 0)) <= bool 108000) or (0 * count((longhorn_volume_last_backup_at{cluster="k8s-prod",pvc_namespace=~"$namespace",pvc=~"$pvc"} unless on (cluster,pvc_namespace,pvc) longhorn:volume_backup_exempt{cluster="k8s-prod"}))) or ((count((longhorn_volume_capacity_bytes{cluster="k8s-prod",pvc_namespace=~"$namespace",pvc=~"$pvc"} unless on (cluster,pvc_namespace,pvc) longhorn:volume_backup_exempt{cluster="k8s-prod"})) or (0 * count(longhorn_volume_capacity_bytes{cluster="k8s-prod",pvc_namespace=~"$namespace",pvc=~"$pvc"}))) == 0)

panels.title: Recent backup

panels.description: Positive backup timestamp older than 30 hours, matching the per-volume alert threshold before its 15-minute pending period. Shows zero when all selected volumes are explicitly exempt; if every expected volume lacks a timestamp, this shows No data. Partial gaps are counted in Missing timestamps.

targets.expr: sum((time() - ((longhorn_volume_last_backup_at{cluster="k8s-prod",pvc_namespace=~"$namespace",pvc=~"$pvc"} unless on (cluster,pvc_namespace,pvc) longhorn:volume_backup_exempt{cluster="k8s-prod"}) > 0)) > bool 108000) or (0 * count((longhorn_volume_last_backup_at{cluster="k8s-prod",pvc_namespace=~"$namespace",pvc=~"$pvc"} unless on (cluster,pvc_namespace,pvc) longhorn:volume_backup_exempt{cluster="k8s-prod"}))) or ((count((longhorn_volume_capacity_bytes{cluster="k8s-prod",pvc_namespace=~"$namespace",pvc=~"$pvc"} unless on (cluster,pvc_namespace,pvc) longhorn:volume_backup_exempt{cluster="k8s-prod"})) or (0 * count(longhorn_volume_capacity_bytes{cluster="k8s-prod",pvc_namespace=~"$namespace",pvc=~"$pvc"}))) == 0)

panels.title: Stale backup

panels.description: Timestamp is zero. New volumes appear immediately here; the alert allows 30 hours to complete the first backup. Shows zero when all selected volumes are explicitly exempt; if every expected volume lacks a timestamp, this shows No data. Partial gaps are counted in Missing timestamps.

targets.expr: sum((longhorn_volume_last_backup_at{cluster="k8s-prod",pvc_namespace=~"$namespace",pvc=~"$pvc"} unless on (cluster,pvc_namespace,pvc) longhorn:volume_backup_exempt{cluster="k8s-prod"}) == bool 0) or ((count((longhorn_volume_capacity_bytes{cluster="k8s-prod",pvc_namespace=~"$namespace",pvc=~"$pvc"} unless on (cluster,pvc_namespace,pvc) longhorn:volume_backup_exempt{cluster="k8s-prod"})) or (0 * count(longhorn_volume_capacity_bytes{cluster="k8s-prod",pvc_namespace=~"$namespace",pvc=~"$pvc"}))) == 0)

panels.title: Never backed up

panels.description: Expected volumes without a backup timestamp metric. A zero timestamp is counted separately as Never backed up.
panels.title: Missing timestamps

panels.description: Intentional no-backup PVCs. If the exemption metric disappears, these volumes return to the backup-expected set, matching the alert rules.
panels.title: Backup opt-outs

panels.description: Only volumes with a successful backup appear. Never-backed-up and missing timestamps are counted above. Opt-outs are excluded.
panels.title: Last successful backup age

panels.description: Only explicitly opted-out volumes appear. An empty table is expected when none of the selected PVCs are exempt.
panels.title: Excluded from scheduled backups
Capacity · node panels cover the whole cluster
Node disk space
panels.description: Physical disk usage and free capacity, including replicas and snapshots. Free space includes space reserved for the system; it is not all schedulable.

panels.title: Replica allocation and reservable capacity
panels.description: Scheduled replica sizes are logical allocations and may exceed physical capacity under thin provisioning. Compare physical disk space separately.
Longhorn actual size includes snapshot data. It is not filesystem usage inside the PVC and may exceed provisioned size.
panels.title: Volume actual size

panels.description: Logical volume size, not the total physical space consumed by its replicas.
panels.title: Volume provisioned size
